newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia pulls Helsinki up to flat close.
newsitem.headline: Nokia pulls Helsinki up to flat close.

text.p: Shares recovered from early weakness to end flat, helped by Nokia which jumped briefly on a Salomon Brothers report that toyed with the idea of a link-up with Microsoft, brokers said.

The FOX stock futures index fell 0.17 percent to 1,097.00, while the all-share HEX rose 0.04 percent to 3,209.94 points. The FOX ended 2.5 percent for the week. Volume was fair at 450 million markka, building up after a slow start.
After a heavy-volume week, brokers said the market had grown cautious due to jitters over the direction of the U.S. market and ahead of the U.S. Fed's policy meeting next week.
Nokia ended 2.00 markka higher at 390.30 in moderately lively 230 million markka volume on an otherwise quiet bourse.

It was helped briefly to an intraday high of 393.00 by a Salomon Brothers research report that reaffirmed a buy on Nokia at 390.00 markka and said that while a merger with Microsoft wouldn't happen, "it's fun to think about."
"After everyone else had upgraded, somebody had to come up with something completely schizo," one broker said.
Raisio closed a volatile week with further losses, ending down 1.10 markka at 361.90 after bottoming out at 350.00, which brokers said looked like the new support level.
